snippet:
import requests
API = "http://127.0.0.1:3900"
job = requests.post(f"{API}/dub/upload", data={"source_lang": "en"},
    files={"video": open("scene.mp4", "rb")}).json()["job_id"]
for s in requests.post(f"{API}/dub/transcribe/{job}").json()["segments"]:
    print(s["start"], s["speaker_id"], s["text"])
checks: Scored against the real turns: 68% of the speech time to the right speaker
